prompt: Pernyataan manakah yang paling tepat merangkum gagasan utama bacaan?
passage: Many students believe that studying late at night is the best way to prepare for an exam. Researchers, however, have found that the brain consolidates memories while we sleep. In one study, students who slept seven hours after learning a list of words remembered about twenty percent more than those who stayed awake. Another example comes from a school that moved its exams to later in the morning. These examples suggest that sleep is part of the learning process itself, not a waste of study time. Her conclusion is clear: good rest is one of the most useful study tools a student can have.
